chunks: Do you wonder that a warning has come to you from your Lord through a man who is one of you, to warn you and that you may fear God, and perhaps you will be shown mercy?

key_terms.تَتَّقُوا: That you may fear God / attain God-consciousness
key_terms.ذِكْرٌ: The reminder or the Qur'an, divine message

ai.seo_question: Why did the Qurayh wonder that the Prophet was a man from among them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the legitimacy of prophethood through human agency, countering the Meccans' arrogance that a mere mortal could bear divine revelation. It underscores the purpose of the Prophet's mission as a warning to foster taqwa (God-consciousness) and elicit rahma (mercy), reflecting the Imami understanding of the Prophet as the perfect human exemplar. The rhetorical question challenges the notion that divine communication requires a non-human mediator, affirming the accessibility of guidance through chosen individuals from among the people.
